extraction_point: after the SENSO parent prefix is reconstructed and before unchanged continuation
note: Groups A–E are candidates declared in METHOD_EXPERIMENT_CONTRACT_V2.md Section 4. The subset selected and frozen at F0 replaces this file with a fully specified, SHA-256-committed version. No feature may be added or removed after F0.

group_A_output_set_entropy.description: Structural properties of per-channel output-function-set distributions

features.name: output_set_entropy
features.formula: Shannon entropy of channel output-set-size distribution, normalised by log(13)

features.name: output_set_gini
features.formula: Gini coefficient of channel output-set sizes, normalised to [0,1]

group_B_coverage_and_symmetry.description: Comparator-pair coverage, depth histogram, and symmetry indicator

features.name: pair_coverage
features.formula: distinct channel pairs used in prefix  /  78

features.name: prefix_symmetric
features.formula: 1.0 if prefix comparator list equals channel-reversal of itself else 0.0

group_C_progress_velocity.description: Rolling output-set reduction rate and stall detection

features.name: velocity_4
features.formula: mean output-set size reduction per comparator over last min(4, prefix_count) comparators  /  8192

features.name: velocity_8
features.formula: mean output-set size reduction per comparator over last min(8, prefix_count) comparators  /  8192

features.name: velocity_16
features.formula: mean output-set size reduction per comparator over last min(16, prefix_count) comparators  /  8192

features.name: stall_fraction_8
features.formula: proportion of last min(8, prefix_count) comparators that produced zero total output-set reduction

features.name: parent_hof_rank
features.formula: parent hall-of-fame rank  /  200  (0 if parent is rank-0 best)

group_E_extra_seeds.description: Additional n=13 target-45 SENSO runs on seeds 1001–1020 to supply positive labels from diverse starting points
constraints: Must use the same frozen SENSO binary and configuration as development seeds
Must be declared and frozen at F0 before any run
Must pass the same instrumentation-on/off trajectory sentinel
Disjoint from all predecessor seed partitions (1–20, validation set, E3/E4 holdouts)

inherited_features_from_v1.description: All 85 v1 features are retained as the base; v2 appends the selected candidate groups above

post_extraction_standardization.fit_on: PENDING_F0_FREEZE — will include positive-bearing training seeds; exact seed list frozen at F0
post_extraction_standardization.export: one mean and one scale per feature in checkpoint

explicit_omissions: No exact unsorted-input or counterexample enumeration: recomputing all 8192 inputs for every dataset row would materially change throughput.
No 44-comparator budget, indicator, label, reward, or feature.
No seed identifier, candidate identity, verifier result, wall time, or holdout metadata is a model input.
